marker.step_source:
import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

marker.step_source:
head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

Phase `bob-cli-c9.4.1.9.2` is done and closed.

What landed, by phase item:

- **Task alias**: the executor rewrites the alias only when the staged title differs from the planned title, preserving the old ` (vN)` suffix or adding none. Unchanged titles (including custom aliases) stay byte-identical. New helper `ref_tasks::overwrite_task_alias`.
- **Output lines**: `overwrite: <type>/<stem> (<status> · <N> highlights)`, `task: kept <path> ^<id> [<mark>] <status>` with the final mark/status (kept-closed hint now inline: `· pass -s ready to reopen`), `audio: kept <path> (narrates the replaced capture; add -L to re-narrate)`, and `sync: committed <sha7>` (push-pending text unchanged). Dry runs preview the same plan and end with `writes: none`.
- **Play link**: markdown and vault-note overwrite renders now bind the same listen URI ordinary create would, so kept/replaced audio keeps the Play link.
- **Narration diagnostics**: on any post-listen failure (executor included), all routes keep the scratch episode and print `kept: <path>` via `post_listen_error`.
- **Audio extension**: `-a clip.m4a` publishes `report.m4a` at the library stem; the old companion is deleted in the same preimage-checked transaction and the note embed follows it.
- **keep_user_fields**: preflight carries non-empty `aliases`/`topics`/`research` into the replacement marker (explicit capture values win) on every route; sync flows them into the live note.
- **Docs**: corrected the stale force claims in `docs/highlights-clip.md`, fixed the Dedupe claim in `docs/highlights-create.md`, and documented the overwrite report lines, no-archive line, push-pending, and refusal codes.

Verification actually run: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features` with the repo gate (`-D unused -D private_interfaces`, exit 0, no new warnings), `just docs-gen` + `just docs-check` (447 passed), `cargo test --lib` (3534 ok), `cargo test --test cli` (2188 ok, including 8 new tests in `tests/cli/highlights/overwrite_local.rs` plus tightened assertions in `overwrite_web.rs` and `create.rs`).
